basis: Two-week volume ratios 0.70 / 0.45; long-run ratios 0.70 / 0.50; quality plan for 1 session is 1 / 1. W1 volume = 50 * 0.70 = 35; long run = 21 * 0.70 = 14.7 -> 15. W2 volume = 50 * 0.45 = 22.5 -> 23; long run = 21 * 0.50 = 10.5 -> 11. Taper ratio = 22.5 / 50 * 100 = 45.0% on the raw last-week volume. Days to race 14 equals 2 * 7, so the window is sufficient; half distance has no marathon low-volume warning.
